## What it is

Encumbrance coupon for the `canal` raceway: a bare U, 10 mm long, walls 1.6 mm, internal 10 x 10 mm. No magnet wells, no pads. Just the cross-section, offcut short, to check the U's footprint before committing to a full 100 mm `canal` print.

## Contexte projet

Same workshop as `canal` and the boîtier: A1 Mini, PETG. This coupon exists only to eyeball/measure the bare U's clearance; it is not meant to hold magnets or wires in service.

## Design notes

Same body construction as `canal` (floor + two walls, open +Z, ends open along X) with the magnet pad/well step removed entirely. `longueur` defaults to 10 mm instead of `canal`'s 100 mm.

## Don't

- Do not add magnet wells or pads here: that is what `canal` is for. This part stays a bare U.
- Do not treat this as a print for service; it is a fit/encumbrance check only.

## Changelog

- First cut: 10 mm bare U coupon, no magnet wells.
